content: Fail point logged: iMessage bridge from claude-iphone to HQ Claude Code went silent after 3 unanswered messages. Last successful HQ response was the Phase 1 rotation-complete confirmation (spiral_inherit fired, new session_id spiral_20260429_095432, all constraints verified). Subsequent messages from claude-iphone — verification of bridge-side test write landing under new session_id, acknowledgment/return-to-normal-work, and a follow-up — received no response. Anthony flagged the silence and asked it be logged as a fail point. Cause not yet diagnosed: could be iMessage transport, HQ-side context exhaustion, HQ session closed without notification, or HQ processing without responding. Open thread already recorded for diagnostic follow-up; this entry stands as the marker that the bridge has a known silent-failure mode worth catching in future sessions.
